objective.subject: fix: address the second adversarial review and the await-all PIT gap
objective.body:
Round 2 reviewed ce7b5cc2..6bd5d76e.

- Run join-policy-await-all-6bd5d76e-20261128-132352-aa2610 (codex on
  zcode/GLM-5.4): its JSON was malformed, so the run recorded failed and is
  resumed. Its readable output found no behavior regression and one P3,
  confirmed: TaskBatchResult's class Javadoc still listed close() among the
  cancellation sources after round 1 removed it elsewhere. Removed.
- Run ...-132357-59b0e2 (codex on deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro): one P2, rejected.
  It claims removing the synchronous failFastCancel() on a combine failure
  lets a nested scope "submitted and not joined" inside a member outlive an
  AWAIT_ALL group. Every public nested entry (Par.map, mapAndCombine,
  runAll) is synchronous, so a member's nested scopes have finished before the
  member settles; the combine runs only after every member succeeded, and its
  own nested scopes finish before it fails. Nothing bound below the group
  token is still running when the combine fails, so no propagation is lost.

PIT on Par after 6bd5d76e left Par#allSucceeded and the await-all submit path
without coverage: no test ran an AWAIT_ALL mapAndCombine whose elements all
succeeded. mapAndCombineRunsTheCombineWhenEveryElementSucceeded covers it, and
allSucceeded treats a cancelled future through the same getDone path instead
of a separate isCancelled check.
